question: During puberty, a woman's first menstrual flow is known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**menarche**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Menarche **is the term for a female adolescent's **first** **menstrual cycle.**
 
• The average age at which menarche starts is **12.4 years,** and it often happens between the ages of** 10 **and** 16.**
 
• However, **socioeconomic level, genetics, general health, dietary status, physical activity, seasonality, **and **family size** are likely to be significant menarcheal age-related **factors**.
 
• Menarche often occurs **abruptly **and **painlessly**.
 
• The early cycles, which are typically **anovulatory**, can differ in length and flow.
 
• Menarche, which denotes the beginning of **sexual maturity**, is closely related to the **maturation **of **secondary sexual characteristics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Menopause: **

 
 
• During **menopause**, your menstrual periods come to an **end**.
 
• It is diagnosed after **12 months without menstruation.**
 
• The average age in US is **51**, even though menopause might start in your **40s or 50s.**
 
 
 
• **Menorrhagia:**
 
 
• **​Menorrhagia **is the term for prolonged **menstrual bleeding **that lasts longer than** seven days**.
 
• The danger of **severe bleeding **is another.
 
 
 
• **Amenorrhea:**
 
 
• **​****Missing **one or more **menstrual periods **refers to the **absence **of **menstruation**, commonly known as **amenorrhea**.
